stories.headline: Rust Code Now Powers 12 Percent of New Linux Kernel Commits
stories.excerpt: The Rust-for-Linux project crossed a milestone this month: more than one in ten new kernel patches merged in the latest cycle were written in Rust. Driver authors cite memory-safety guarantees as the primary motivator, while long-time C maintainers remain cautious about toolchain complexity.
stories.licenceBasis: Hacker News public API — titles and links, discussion linked out

stories.headline: Passkey Adoption Hits 2 Billion Accounts as Passwords Fade From Consumer Apps
stories.excerpt: The FIDO Alliance reports that passkey-enabled accounts crossed two billion worldwide, with the steepest adoption curve in banking and government services. Password-only login is now the minority experience on major platforms for the first time.
stories.licenceBasis: TechCrunch RSS excerpt with link-out, per feed terms of use

stories.headline: Lab-Grown Coral Survives Third Summer in Great Barrier Reef Restoration Trial
stories.excerpt: Heat-tolerant coral fragments cultured in a Queensland laboratory and transplanted three years ago have survived consecutive bleaching seasons, maintaining 87 percent tissue coverage. Researchers call it the longest field success for assisted gene flow in reef restoration.
stories.licenceBasis: ScienceDaily release summary with attribution and link-out

stories.headline: U.S. Existing-Home Sales Rise for Third Straight Month as Mortgage Rates Dip Below 6 Percent
stories.excerpt: The National Association of Realtors reports a 4.2 percent month-over-month increase in closed sales, the longest sustained uptick since early 2022. Median prices remain elevated but inventory has climbed to its highest level in 18 months.

stories.headline: Northern Sea Route Records Busiest August as Ice-Free Window Widens
stories.excerpt: Vessel transits through the Arctic's Northern Sea Route reached a single-month record in August, driven by container lines testing shorter Asia-to-Europe paths. Environmental groups warn the traffic spike threatens marine ecosystems already stressed by warming.

stories.headline: npm Registry Blocks 1,400 Typosquatting Packages in Largest Single Sweep
stories.excerpt: GitHub's security team removed over 1,400 malicious packages designed to impersonate popular libraries through name confusion. The packages, uploaded across a two-week window, contained credential-harvesting scripts targeting CI environments.

stories.headline: Voyager 1 Regains Full Science Return After 18-Month Firmware Patch Relay
stories.excerpt: NASA confirms that all four active instruments on Voyager 1 are now transmitting usable data again after engineers completed a multi-step memory workaround beamed across 24 billion kilometers. The spacecraft, launched in 1977, continues to operate in interstellar space.

stories.headline: Grid-Scale Iron-Air Batteries Clear 100-Hour Discharge Milestone
stories.excerpt: A Massachusetts startup demonstrated a containerized iron-air battery system sustaining output for over 100 hours at grid scale — roughly four times the duration of lithium-ion systems. The chemistry uses abundant, non-toxic materials, though round-trip efficiency remains below 50 percent.
stories.licenceBasis: EurekAlert press release — redistribution with attribution permitted

stories.headline: Large Trial Links Consistent Sleep Schedules to 28 Percent Lower Cardiovascular Risk
stories.excerpt: A prospective study tracking 73,000 adults over six years found that participants with irregular sleep-wake timing faced significantly higher rates of heart disease, independent of total sleep duration. Regularity, not just hours, emerged as the stronger predictor.
stories.licenceBasis: PubMed abstract — public access per NLM terms

stories.headline: Enterprise AI Agent Deployments Triple in Six Months, Survey Finds
stories.excerpt: A survey of 500 enterprises shows that production deployments of autonomous AI agents — systems that take multi-step actions without human approval — grew 210 percent between Q1 and Q3 2026. Customer service and internal IT remain the dominant use cases.

stories.headline: UN Report: 2.1 Billion People Still Lack Safely Managed Drinking Water
stories.excerpt: The latest Joint Monitoring Programme update shows progress has stalled in sub-Saharan Africa and parts of South Asia, where population growth outpaces infrastructure investment. The report calls for tripling current spending to meet 2030 targets.

stories.headline: Tokamak Sustains Burning Plasma for 8 Minutes in New Record Run
stories.excerpt: South Korea's KSTAR reactor held a sustained fusion reaction at over 100 million degrees for 480 seconds, breaking its own record. The result advances the timeline for demonstrating net energy gain in magnetic confinement fusion.
